title: Start with a block
description: cube() uses [X, Y, Z] dimensions. Here the block is 30 × 20 × 6 mm.

title: Move a shape
description: translate() moves the block 10 mm in X and 6 mm in Y. Its size stays the same; compare its position with the origin axes.

title: Join two shapes
description: union() joins the overlapping block and cylinder. The cylinder begins at Z=5, overlapping the 6 mm block by 1 mm.

title: Cut a hole
description: difference() keeps the first shape and removes the later ones. The cutting cylinder extends beyond both faces of the block.

title: Give a 2D shape height
description: Make a flat square with a circular hole, then lift that 2D outline into a 6 mm thick part. Compare it with the previous model.

title: Turn a shape
description: Read from the shape outward: create the block, rotate it 35° about Z at the origin, then move it. Changing that order changes the result.

title: Keep only the overlap
description: intersection() keeps the region shared by both shapes. This is different from joining them or subtracting one from the other.

title: Our PCB stand — print this
description: Open stand with wider posts: 12 mm at the foot, 8 mm at the top, and 3.4 mm screw holes. Check screw fit and solder-joint clearance before assembly.

title: Our PCB — reference only
description: Actual board outline, 1.6 mm thickness and all 72 drilled holes, reconstructed from KiCad. Components, copper and solder are not shown. This is a reference model, not a printable electronic PCB.

title: Stand + PCB — check the fit
description: Blue: printable stand. Green: PCB reference, seated on the posts. The board is shown without components or solder. Check the real assembly before choosing screw length.

title: M3 screw-fit test — print first
description: From the notched end: 3.2, 3.4, then 3.6 mm nominal holes. Try your M3 screw in the printed test piece before printing the stand.
